'''Lurbi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] from the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar 4]]. Lurbi operated [[Lurbi's Mercantile]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located in the [[Landing]], a settlement situated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]].
